    */\n    fun parseSchemaObjects(): SchemaObjects {\n        if (!options.introspectionEnabled) {\n empty array [] is equivalent to [null]\n        if (value.values.isEmpty()) {\n            return NullValue.newNullValue().build()\n        }\n\n        // get rid of null values\n        val
